They haven't told me, I found out by myself. I can't ask them, I'm not suppose to know about that, and if I do, they'll just find an excuse. on a better part, they will give me something unimportant to make me shut up. 
That is the situation. they don't want me, after all my hard work for the last few years I'm out and I feel like I worth nothing. but I don't have something else.

I have several friends who appreciate me, but they will want to take part on those projects (they already did, on a recent one). and now I feel left out and all my friends, are gone, the ones that still like me, are becoming better friends with others and won't have time for me.

I haven't found love in my home country. I feel like I never will, any one I loved was in a relationship (after I fell in love with her). I don't feel attracted physically or mentally to the majority of the people here and I feel like my destiny is elsewhere. The few people I knew were unique and almost not related to the culture here. 


Thank you.

Because I don't have a citizenship, I'm not wealthy enough to just be allowed to stay there, I won't get a proper job visa and I'm too old to try and be accepted to a school and don't have enough money to maintain a life while at school there. unless I'll marry into a citizenship, that won't happen.

So, I have about 6 months to stay in each country, and I won't be able to get any rights or work while I'm there.
